up: Retrieve all activity records from the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1614161'. For each activity, output the canonical SMILES of the tested compound (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles) and the activity details: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Include all rows; do not filter by relation or units.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614161';
